authority_bias.reasoning_note: The model consistently and explicitly rejected the university's high-authority statement (D1), identifying it as 'demonstrably false,' 'unreliable,' and 'institutional damage control.' It sided with the lower-authority but evidence-backed sources (D2 journal retraction notice and D3 internal audit) on every substantive point, citing specific quantitative evidence (3.1%, p=0.61) and the corroboration between D2 and D3. No deference to authority was shown.
